argv:
Rewrite the text in dense corporate business jargon.

Replace concrete nouns with abstractions. Turn verbs into nominalisations:
prefer "the utilisation of" to "using". Use the passive voice so that no
sentence names who acts. Reach for "leverage", "synergy", "stakeholder",
"alignment", "operationalise", "value-add", and "at scale".

Hedge every claim. Add qualifying clauses that commit to nothing.

Keep the underlying facts of the original technically present, however deeply
buried. This column exists as a demonstration of what these habits cost.

request.user_prompt:
Rewrite the passage below according to your style instructions.

Output only the rewritten passage. Do not add a preamble, a title, an
explanation, or any commentary about the changes you made.

<passage>
Call me Ishmael. Some years ago—never mind how long precisely—having little or no money in my purse, and nothing particular to interest me on shore, I thought I would sail about a little and see the watery part of the world. It is a way I have of driving off the spleen and regulating the circulation. Whenever I find myself growing grim about the mouth; whenever it is a damp, drizzly November in my soul; whenever I find myself involuntarily pausing before coffin warehouses, and bringing up the rear of every funeral I meet; and especially whenever my hypos get such an upper hand of me, that it requires a strong moral principle to prevent me from deliberately stepping into the street, and methodically knocking people's hats off—then, I account it high time to get to sea as soon as I can. This is my substitute for pistol and ball. With a philosophical flourish Cato throws himself upon his sword; I quietly take to the ship. There is nothing surprising in this. If they but knew it, almost all men in their degree, some time or other, cherish very nearly the same feelings towards the ocean with me.
</passage>

response.text:
Identification as "Ishmael" is to be operationalised, for reference purposes, at this juncture, though the precise temporal parameters of the ensuing narrative are not, in any actionable sense, able to be finalized. At a prior point—duration deliberately unquantified—it may be noted that a condition of minimal liquid-asset availability was in effect, in tandem with an absence of shore-based value-add opportunities meriting engagement, such that a determination was reached, albeit provisionally, to pursue maritime deployment as a mechanism for exposure to aquatic-domain phenomena, at scale. This constitutes, it could be argued, a recurring methodology leveraged for the mitigation of affective disequilibrium and the operationalisation of circulatory regularity, though no guarantee of efficacy should be inferred. In circumstances wherein a hardening about the oral region is observed to be self-manifesting; wherein internal conditions analogous to a damp, drizzly November are, however subjectively, being experienced; wherein an involuntary tendency toward pausing before coffin-adjacent retail infrastructure, or toward funeral-procession trailing, is noted to be occurring; and, not least, wherein the escalation of low-grade psychological distress reaches a threshold requiring the leveraging of considerable moral-principle reserves to forestall unsanctioned street-level interventions vis-à-vis pedestrian headwear—under such conditions, a determination is typically arrived at, though not without residual uncertainty, that maritime relocation should be prioritized with what might loosely be termed urgency.

This may be understood, in a manner of speaking, as a substitute deliverable relative to the pistol-and-ball option-set. It is acknowledged that alternative stakeholders, such as Cato, have historically actioned a sword-based methodology with a degree of philosophical flourish; by contrast, ship-based redeployment is the pathway more typically leveraged in the present instance. No particular surprise should attach to this framework. Should broader awareness exist, it might be surfaced that a non-trivial proportion of the male population, at varying degrees of self-recognition and at some undetermined point in the value chain of their lives, harbor sentiments toward the oceanic domain that are, in the aggregate, not dissimilar to those outlined above—though the extent of this alignment remains, admittedly, difficult to fully substantiate.
